issues.title: Knowledge preview lightbox: focus never enters the dialog and is not trapped or returned, and the hidden dialog stays exposed as aria-modal
issues.file: knowledge.html:114-125 (markup), knowledge.html:218-225 (.lb hidden only by opacity), knowledge.html:441-465 (openPreview/closeLightbox)
issues.description: The document preview is the main action on /knowledge. openPreview() only adds the .open class. It never moves focus into #lightbox, never traps Tab, and closeLightbox() never restores focus. While closed, #lightbox is hidden only by opacity:0/pointer-events:none, so its role='dialog' aria-modal='true' container, close button and download link stay in the accessibility tree and in the Tab order. Some screen readers treat an exposed aria-modal dialog as modal and hide the rest of the page.
reproduction_steps: Open /knowledge and Tab to the first card's 'พรีวิว' button
Press Enter: the lightbox opens, but document.activeElement is still the 'พรีวิว' button behind the overlay
Press Tab 4 times: focus cycles 'โหลด' → 'พรีวิว' → 'โหลด' → 'พรีวิว' on the cards under the overlay (closest('#lightbox') is false for every stop)
Before opening anything, the closed lightbox's 'ปิด' button and 'ดาวน์โหลด' link are Tab stops at opacity 0
issues.user_impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users open a preview but stay stuck behind it. They cannot reach the close button or the PDF iframe without tabbing through the whole page, and screen-reader users may lose the page content because an always-present aria-modal dialog is exposed.
issues.recommended_fix: Use a native <dialog> with showModal(), as gallery.js already does, or add the hidden attribute / visibility:hidden (or inert) while closed. On open, save document.activeElement, focus #lbClose and trap Tab. On close, restore focus to the opener.
issues.evidence: Keyboard run in the browser: after Enter on .doc-open, {open:true, active:'btn btn--primary doc-open', inLB:false}. Focus log after 4 Tabs: ['A.doc-dl:โหลด:inLB=false','BUTTON.doc-open:พรีวิว:inLB=false','A.doc-dl:โหลด:inLB=false','BUTTON.doc-open:พรีวิว:inLB=false']. Closed state: getComputedStyle(#lightbox) opacity '0', visibility 'visible', hidden=false, aria-hidden=null. The hidden-focusable scan lists 'BUTTON:ปิด' and 'A:ดาวน์โหลด'.

resolution.change: knowledge.html: lightbox inert while closed, focus moves to close button, Tab trapped, Escape closes, focus returns to opener, #doc= cleared

issues.title: Ctrl/Cmd+S and 'บันทึกและดูตัวอย่าง' bypass the save busy-guard, so new items get inserted twice
issues.description: submit() disables only the button that was clicked. The Ctrl/Cmd+S handler calls submit(false) without checking any in-flight state, and the other footer button stays enabled. For a new record, isNew stays true until the first insert resolves, so a second trigger sends a second INSERT. A double-click on the same button is safe, because it is disabled synchronously.
reproduction_steps: Open /.claude/audit/admin-mock with localStorage.mock_session='1'
กิจกรรม → เพิ่มกิจกรรม, type a title
Press Ctrl+S twice quickly (or hold it so the key repeats)
Alternative: click 'บันทึกร่าง' and then immediately 'บันทึกและดูตัวอย่าง'
issues.user_impact: Duplicate activities/docs/albums/places/members appear on the live site, and the admin has to find and delete them by hand.
issues.recommended_fix: Keep one `saving` flag per form. Return early from submit() while it is set, and disable both footer buttons, Ctrl+S included, until the request settles. Ignore e.repeat in the keydown handler.
issues.evidence: Mock run: two synthetic ctrl+s keydowns gave rows 4→6 with 2 rows titled 'AUDIT double save test'. Save-then-preview click gave 2 rows 'AUDIT save+preview'. A double-click on save gave 1 row (guarded).

resolution.change: assets/admin.js: single `saving` lock shared by save, preview and Ctrl/Cmd+S; both buttons disabled while saving; key repeat ignored

issues.title: Changed public CSS/JS have no cache-busting, and stale-while-revalidate=7d serves old JS with new HTML

issues.title: Upcoming activities that are not pinned as 'featured' never appear on the public site
issues.file: assets/api.js:496-507 (renderFeatured pool), assets/api.js:1115-1117 (renderPastCarousel only past), assets/api.js:331 (renderActivities never called); assets/admin.js featured hint
issues.description: renderFeatured uses `pool = feat.length ? feat : items`. While any activity has featured=true, upcoming activities without the flag are filtered out. The only other activity list on /activities and the home page is renderPastCarousel, which shows only date < today. MCCMU.renderActivities exists but no page calls it. Live /data today: 19 published activities, exactly one featured (2026-10-11). The admin form hint ('กิจกรรมเด่นจะขึ้นเป็นการ์ดใหญ่ในหน้าแรกและหน้ากิจกรรม') suggests unpinned activities still show somewhere smaller.

issues.title: Auto-scrolling carousels have no pause control, ignore prefers-reduced-motion and keep moving while focused
issues.file: assets/api.js:1131-1166 (_initCarousel: setInterval(tick, 3800) with no reduced-motion check), knowledge.html:330-360 (doc carousel setInterval(advance, 3500))
issues.description: _initCarousel and the knowledge doc carousel auto-advance every 3.5-3.8 s. They pause only on mouseenter/touch, not on focusin, offer no pause/stop button (WCAG 2.2.2), and ignore prefers-reduced-motion. The featured slider (api.js:478) does check reduced motion, so the two code paths are inconsistent.
reproduction_steps: Open /halal-map with the keyboard and Tab into a card's 'เปิดแผนที่' link
Wait about 4 s: the track scrolls by one card, so the focused card can move out of view
With OS 'reduce motion' on, the carousels still auto-scroll (no matchMedia check in _initCarousel)
issues.user_impact: Content moves under keyboard and screen-magnifier users while they read. Users with vestibular disorders get continuous motion they asked the OS to suppress.
issues.recommended_fix: In _initCarousel and the doc carousel, skip the interval when matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') matches, pause on focusin and resume on focusout, and add a visible pause/play toggle (aria-pressed) next to the prev/next buttons.

Other offenders: footer h4 'เมนู/เนื้อหา/ติดต่อเรา' at 1.56px plus uppercase on all pages; header .brand__en 'มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่' at 1.68px plus uppercase on all pages; /activities p.feat-upcoming 'กิจกรรมเด่นเร็ว ๆ นี้' at 1.2px plus uppercase; /about .donate-card__label 'เลขที่บัญชี/ชื่อบัญชี' at 0.96px plus uppercase and .donate-card__tag 'บัญชีบริจาค' at 0.55px; lang toggle 'ไทย' at 0.48px. The prayer strip already overrides .eyebrow correctly (mccmu.css:353). This contradicts the project's own rule in mccmu.css:352 and admin.css:165. The same styles are on production, so this is pre-existing.
reproduction_steps: Open /about at 1280x800.
Inspect any section eyebrow, for example 'เกี่ยวกับเรา About us'. The computed letter-spacing is 2px and text-transform is uppercase.

issues.recommended_fix: Scope the tracking to the Latin part only. For example, set letter-spacing:0 and text-transform:none on .eyebrow, .footer h4, .brand__en, .feat-upcoming and .donate-card__label/__tag, then add .eyebrow .en, .footer h4:lang(en) { letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase }. Alternatively wrap the Latin text in <span class="en"> and keep tracking only on .en. Also move .brand__en's Thai text out of the uppercase span.

issues.title: Admin loads supabase-js from jsdelivr at floating @2 without integrity
issues.description: import { createClient } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/+esm' resolves to whatever the newest 2.x is at load time and cannot be pinned with SRI (ES module import). Any malicious or broken 2.x release, or a CDN compromise, runs with full access to the admin session token, and so to every table through RLS as an owner. It can also break the admin unexpectedly on a minor release.
reproduction_steps: grep -n jsdelivr assets/admin.js
issues.user_impact: Supply-chain risk to the one page that can write to the production database. Unpredictable upgrades.
issues.recommended_fix: Pin an exact version (e.g. @supabase/supabase-js@2.x.y/+esm), or vendor the ESM bundle into /assets/vendor/ and serve it same-origin. Combine with a CSP script-src allowlist.
issues.evidence: [security] assets/admin.js:14 imports '...supabase-js@2/+esm'; admin/index.html has no integrity attributes. || [production] assets/admin.js:14 import ... from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/+esm' || [performance] curl outputs: sb entry 12,500B; auth-js 108,919; functions-js 3,455; postgrest-js 18,163; realtime-js 33,504; storage-js 45,925.

issues.title: No CSP, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options or Referrer-Policy (admin can be framed)
issues.description: Production returns only HSTS (Vercel default). With no frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, any site can load /admin in an invisible iframe, and a signed-in admin (session persisted in localStorage) can be clickjacked into actions such as delete, publish or changing roles. Some of these have confirm() dialogs, but plain save, publish and delete buttons are single clicks. With no CSP, any future injection (see the settings-href issue) has no second line of defense and could exfiltrate the admin token anywhere.
reproduction_steps: curl -sI https://mccmuclub.vercel.app/admin | grep -iE 'content-security|x-frame|x-content-type|referrer-policy'  (no output)

Because there is no X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors header, a page containing <iframe src='https://mccmuclub.vercel.app/admin'> is not blocked by the browser (inferred from the headers, not tested in a browser)
issues.user_impact: Clickjacking of signed-in admins, and no defense in depth against XSS that targets the stored admin token.
issues.recommended_fix: Add to vercel.json headers for source '/(.*)': X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin; X-Frame-Options: DENY (or CSP frame-ancestors 'none') at least for /admin. Add a CSP for /admin (script-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; connect-src 'self' https://bzbqzohygnraqquabffg.supabase.co; frame-ancestors 'none'), then a relaxed one for public pages that allows the Google Maps/Drive/YouTube frames.
issues.evidence: curl -I https://mccmuclub.vercel.app/ and /admin: only cache-control and strict-transport-security; no CSP/XFO/nosniff/Referrer-Policy. vercel.json headers define Cache-Control only.

resolution.change: vercel.json: X-Frame-Options DENY, CSP frame-ancestors none, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy (full script CSP not added)

issues.title: Admin email addresses are public through the updated_by column (REST and /data)
issues.description: Content tables have an updated_by column holding the editing admin's email. The anon read policy exposes all columns of published rows, and api/data.js selects select=* and passes rows through unchanged. Every visitor's /data?sheet=all response (edge-cached, and stored in localStorage as mccmu_all_v1) therefore contains the personal Gmail addresses of club admins. These emails are also the identity checked by private.is_admin(), so publishing them hands out a target list for phishing the Google accounts that control the database.
reproduction_steps: curl -s 'https://mccmuclub.vercel.app/data?sheet=all' | jq '[.data.activities[].updated_by] | unique'
or: curl '<SUPABASE_URL>/rest/v1/activities?select=updated_by' -H 'apikey: <anon key>'
issues.user_impact: Personal emails of the student admins are public and indexable. This goes against the project's privacy rule to collect and expose only what is necessary, and gives attackers a phishing target list for admin accounts.
issues.recommended_fix: In api/data.js, select explicit public columns instead of select=*, or strip updated_by/created_at/updated_at in the shape* functions. Also revoke column access for anon: 'revoke select (updated_by) on activities, docs, albums, places, members, settings from anon;', or move updated_by into the audit_log table only.
issues.evidence: Production GET /data?sheet=all: rows with an email in updated_by: activities 8, docs 2, places 11, members 4 (2 distinct gmail.com addresses; values not recorded here). Anon REST select=* returns the same updated_by column.

resolution.change: api/data.js strips updated_by from all public (non-preview) responses — anon REST still exposes the column until a DB column revoke is applied (needs approval)

issues.title: 'ขึ้นเว็บภายใน ~3 นาที' is optimistic: returning visitors, including the admin checking, first see the old content
issues.file: assets/api.js:108-109 (LS_TTL 3 min, LS_MAX 7 days), assets/api.js:127-150 (stale-while-revalidate in _loadAll), api/data.js:31-32 (max-age=120, s-maxage=180, stale-while-revalidate=60); toasts in assets/admin.js submit() and settings save
issues.description: After saving, admin toasts promise the change is live within ~3 minutes. But any browser that visited in the last 7 days with a localStorage cache older than 3 minutes renders the cached copy right away and only fetches new data in the background, so the change appears on the next page load. That fetch can itself hit the HTTP cache (max-age=120) and an edge copy (s-maxage=180 plus 60 s SWR). An admin who publishes, waits 3 minutes and opens the site in the same browser will usually still see the old version.
reproduction_steps: Visit / so localStorage mccmu_all_v1 is filled.
Wait more than 3 minutes, publish a change in admin, then wait the stated ~3 minutes.
Reload /. The first render uses the cached copy (age < LS_MAX). The new data only appears on a later reload.
issues.user_impact: Admins think publishing failed and edit or republish again. Visitors see outdated event info.
issues.recommended_fix: Make the toast honest (for example 'ภายใน ~5 นาที · ถ้ายังไม่เห็นให้รีเฟรชอีกครั้ง'), or let the admin's browser bypass the cache (?fresh or clearing mccmu_all_v1) after a save. Consider a lower LS_MAX for event data.
issues.evidence: Code at the cited lines. The toast text 'บันทึกแล้ว · ขึ้นเว็บภายใน ~3 นาที' was seen after publishing an activity and saving settings in the mock.

A page loaded from any other origin (e.g. *.vercel.app preview deployments, an about:srcdoc frame with empty hostname) still POSTs track_view to production. Observe POST /rest/v1/rpc/track_view in the network panel
issues.user_impact: Preview/staging traffic inflates real visitor statistics.

issues.title: Google Fonts are loaded through an @import inside the render-blocking mccmu.css, with no preconnect, and request an unused weight 300
issues.description: mccmu.css line 6 runs `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anuphan:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Thai:wght@300;…')`. The chain is HTML → mccmu.css (64KB) → fonts.googleapis.com CSS (15.8KB) → woff2. The fonts CSS is discovered only after mccmu.css arrives and blocks rendering. The pages preconnect to lh3.googleusercontent.com and drive.google.com and dns-prefetch the legacy script.google.com, but not to fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com. Weight 300 is requested for both families but used nowhere (CSS weights: 400, 500, 600, 700, 800), which bloats the font CSS with 40 @font-face rules.
reproduction_steps: grep -n '@import' assets/mccmu.css → line 6
On / cold: resources show fonts.googleapis.com css 15,764B, then 7 woff2 (105.6KB), all initiated by css
grep font-weight in assets/*.css → no 300
issues.user_impact: An extra serial DNS+TLS+request before first paint on every first visit, which is noticeable on mobile networks.
issues.recommended_fix: Remove the @import. Put <link rel=preconnect href=https://fonts.googleapis.com> and <link rel=preconnect href=https://fonts.gstatic.com crossorigin> plus a <link rel=stylesheet> for the fonts in each page head (as admin/index.html does). Drop weight 300, and drop the script.google.com dns-prefetch if the Apps Script fallback is no longer primary.
issues.evidence: document.fonts.size = 40, 13 loaded on /. Resource list on / shows the fonts CSS only after mccmu.css.

issues.title: sheet=all runs the aladhan prayer-time call after the Supabase queries, so edge cache misses wait for both in series
issues.description: On an edge cache miss, the handler awaits Promise.all of 5 Supabase queries, then awaits prayerTimes() against api.aladhan.com because it needs settings.prayer_method. Measured: aladhan alone takes about 0.67s cold from here, and a production cache miss took 1.55s versus 0.15s on a HIT. The cache refreshes every 180s (s-maxage) with only 60s of stale-while-revalidate, so some visitors hit the full serial latency. Their first page then waits on it, because there is no localStorage cache yet.
reproduction_steps: curl -w '%{time_total}' https://mccmuclub.vercel.app/data?sheet=all on a MISS (about 1.5s) vs a HIT (about 0.15s)
Read api/data.js:173-182: prayerTimes awaited after Promise.all
issues.user_impact: Up to about 0.7s of extra skeleton time for first-time visitors on a cache miss.
issues.recommended_fix: Start prayerTimes in parallel. Read prayer_method from the settings promise (settingsP.then(s => prayerTimes('', s.prayer_method))) inside the same Promise.all, or cache the method. A longer stale-while-revalidate (for example 600s) would also hide misses.
issues.evidence: Production first request t=1.548s, then 3 HITs at 0.14 to 0.22s with x-vercel-cache: HIT. Local aladhan curl 0.687s and 0.669s.

issues.title: Admin boot makes 15 DB requests in 3 serial rounds, and 5 of them duplicate counts already fetched
issues.description: After getSession, the boot runs admins (1 request). Then refreshCounts() runs 5 HEAD count queries (one per SCHEMA table). Then go('overview') runs loadStats (1), loadContentStats (5 'select status' queries over the same 5 tables), albums (1), album_photos (1) and audit_log (1). That totals 15 PostgREST requests in 3 sequential rounds before the login curtain lifts. loadContentStats already yields the totals that refreshCounts fetched. On list pages, the albums list awaits select('*') and only then runs albumPhotoCounts(), so 2 serial round trips that could run in parallel.
reproduction_steps: Read the call sites listed above
With the real admin and DevTools Network open, filter by 'rest/v1' on login: about 15 requests
issues.user_impact: A slower 'กำลังเตรียมข้อมูล…' wait on login (several serial Supabase round trips), and needless request volume.
issues.recommended_fix: Compute the nav counts from loadContentStats (or the reverse) and run refreshCounts and the overview queries in parallel. In renderList, run the table select and albumPhotoCounts() with Promise.all.
issues.evidence: Code review of admin.js at the lines above. The mock confirms the overview renders after login (rAF test). Exact request counts could not be captured from the mock because the db client is module-private.

issues.title: Login-scene pointermove listener keeps rewriting --px/--py on <html> after login, forcing style recalculation on every mouse move in the admin app
issues.description: startScene() adds a window pointermove listener (for fine pointers) that sets --px and --py on document.documentElement. The listener is never removed when the login view hides. Setting a custom property on the root invalidates style for the whole document on every pointer move, even though .scene is then display:none and nothing uses the values. issues.title: Visitor tracking sends a cross-origin POST with a custom apikey header on every page view, which triggers a CORS preflight, and there is no preconnect
issues.description: Each page view runs fetch(MCCMU_SUPABASE.url + '/rest/v1/rpc/track_view', {method:'POST', headers:{'content-type':'application/json', apikey:…}}). Both a JSON content-type and the apikey header are non-safelisted, so the browser sends an OPTIONS preflight first. That is 2 requests and a fresh TLS connection to *.supabase.co per page load, with no preconnect hint. The preflight can be cached only if Supabase returns Access-Control-Max-Age.
reproduction_steps: Read site.js:202-207
On production, open DevTools Network and filter 'track_view': an OPTIONS and a POST per page view (not verifiable on localhost, where tracking is disabled at site.js:191)
issues.user_impact: Extra connection and request work competing with first-load resources on mobile.
issues.recommended_fix: Send it after load (requestIdleCallback), or proxy it through same-origin /data (for example POST /data?track=1, so no CORS), or use navigator.sendBeacon to a same-origin endpoint.
issues.evidence: Code as cited. The preflight follows from the CORS spec for non-safelisted headers. Not observed live (see not_tested).

issues.title: track_view RPC lets anyone create unlimited page_stats rows and inflate stats
issues.description: track_view is SECURITY DEFINER and executable by anon. The only guard is the path regex ^/[A-Za-z0-9/_.-]*$ (max 120 chars), which accepts any made-up path, so a script can insert an unbounded number of distinct (day, path) rows and increment views/visitors at will. There is no rate limit. The Supabase advisor flags the function (anon_security_definer_function_executable). Inflation is documented as accepted in ADMIN_SETUP.md, but the unbounded new rows are not.
reproduction_steps: Read 0004_page_stats.sql: insert ... on conflict (day, path), with no allowlist of real routes
get_advisors(security) lists public.track_view as anon-executable SECURITY DEFINER
issues.user_impact: Visitor statistics in the admin can't be trusted. Possible DB bloat on the free tier. No data exposure.
issues.recommended_fix: Whitelist the real routes in the function (e.g. clean in ('/','/activities','/gallery','/halal-map','/knowledge','/about')), or map unknown paths to '/other'. Optionally cap views per day.

issues.title: ?src=sheets forwards the raw query (including status=) to the legacy Apps Script
issues.description: Anyone can bypass DATA_SOURCE=supabase with ?src=sheets, and the full query string is proxied to Apps Script, whose byStatus() returns whatever status is requested (archived, draft). The public Sheets data has no non-published rows today, so nothing leaks now, but any archived or draft row added to the legacy sheet would be readable through the site's own domain, and is edge-cached.
reproduction_steps: curl 'https://mccmuclub.vercel.app/data?sheet=activities&src=sheets&status=archived' -> ok:true, 0 rows today
issues.user_impact: Latent exposure of non-published legacy content. Lets anyone switch the backend on the public domain.
issues.recommended_fix: Remove the src override in production (or only honour it with preview auth), and pass only an allowlist of params (sheet, type, date) to Apps Script, never status.
issues.evidence: Production counts: archived 0, draft 0, default 13 published. Code paths cited.

issues.title: Edge function returns internal upstream error details to clients
issues.description: Errors return err.message verbatim, e.g. 'supabase activities: 401', 'supabase places: 400', or 'upstream fetch failed: <runtime error>'. This reveals the backend vendor, table names and upstream status codes. The impact is minor because the schema is public in the repo anyway.
reproduction_steps: curl 'http://localhost:8905/data?sheet=all&preview=1' -H 'Authorization: Bearer aaaaaaaaaa.bbbbbbbbbb.cccccccccc' -> {"ok":false,"error":"supabase activities: 401"}
issues.user_impact: Gives attackers information for probing. No direct data loss.
issues.recommended_fix: Log err.message server-side (console.error) and return a generic error code to the client. For preview, map 401 to the existing 'please sign in again' message.
issues.evidence: Local responses shown above (502 'supabase activities: 401', 502 'supabase places: 400').

incidents.text: The functionality auditor's harness loaded /knowledge in an about:srcdoc iframe; the tracking guard did not catch the empty hostname and one POST rpc/track_view (p_path='srcdoc') reached production. The DB function rejects paths not starting with '/', and a lead read-only query (select … from page_stats where path !~ '^/') returned no rows, so no data was written. Root cause captured as an issue (tracking guard).

notes.text: INCIDENT, needs lead attention. While building a failure-simulation harness I loaded /knowledge into an about:srcdoc iframe. Its hostname is '' (not localhost), so site.js's localhost guard didn't apply and it sent one POST to production Supabase rpc/track_view with p_path='srcdoc' and p_new_visitor=true (localStorage key mccmu_seen_2026-10-13 was set on port 8903). That likely adds +1 view and +1 visitor under path 'srcdoc' in page_stats for 2026-10-13. I did not try to delete it. The owner may want to remove that row. The harness was immediately rebuilt to block all *.supabase.co and non-GET requests and to null MCCMU_SUPABASE.
site.js visitor tracking only excludes file:, localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1]. Any other non-production origin (srcdoc/about:, Vercel preview deployments, LAN IPs) counts toward production stats.
All internal nav and footer links use *.html (site.js:20-25, 78-88), so every click costs an extra 308 hop on Vercel cleanUrls, and the hover prefetch fetches the redirecting URL.
Admin greeting uses device time with h<11 → 'สวัสดีตอนเช้า', so it shows 'Good morning' at 00:35 (admin.js:497-500).
The /gallery page has no active nav item (data-page='gallery' is not in site.js links).
The album 'Steadfastness 2026' is dated 26 ต.ค. 2569, in the future relative to today. Possible data-entry error.
Album sessionStorage cache key is 'mccmu_albums_v2_sheets_published' even though the source is Supabase (api.js:191). Cosmetic, but confusing when debugging.

Halal map: each of the 29 place cards in the swipe carousels embeds a 253x158 interactive Google Maps iframe (pointer-events:auto). On real touch devices a horizontal swipe that starts on the map may pan the map instead of the carousel. Couldn't verify in emulation, so it's not in issues.
29 Google Maps iframes on /halal-map (loading=lazy). Worth checking the cost when scrolling the carousels.

Public drawer: closed links stay focusable (opacity 0 + pointer-events none, no visibility:hidden or inert), there's no Escape to close and no focus move into the drawer, and the burger icon doesn't change to a close icon.
Album photo view filmstrip shows only 4 thumbnails, even at 1440px, for a 154-photo album.
/?preview without an admin session logs '[MCCMU] settings/featured/picks/prayer/members: Error: preview: no admin session' and the page sections don't render content (only the warn bar).
In the album photo view the stage image naturalWidth was 400px, shown at 360x516 on mobile, so the photo-view image may be low resolution on larger screens.
Admin-mock activity list shows a title 'กีฬาสัมพันธ์มุสลิมภาคเหนือ <im…' rendered as literal text, which looks like an XSS probe string in the mock data; it was safely escaped.
On /activities the album card 'Steadfastness 2026' is dated 26 ต.ค. 2569, which is in the future relative to today (13 ต.ค. 2569).
In EN mode, the preview bar buttons ('เข้าสู่ระบบ', 'ออกจากโหมดตัวอย่าง') and its message stayed in Thai.
29 live Google Maps iframes on /halal-map (lazy, but each a full embed) are likely a performance cost too; a static-thumbnail approach would help both lenses.

Preview mode is sticky per tab (sessionStorage mccmu_preview). Opening any ?preview URL without an admin session makes every later page in that tab log '[MCCMU] settings/featured/picks/prayer/past carousel: Error: preview: no admin session', and the data sections stay empty. Seen on :8908 / and on the next /activities load.

gallery.html has no window.MCCMU_SUPABASE inline config (the other 5 public pages have it), so assets/site.js visit tracking returns early and /gallery views are never counted, although admin.js:472 labels '/gallery' in stats.
gallery.html lacks the apple-touch-icon and dns-prefetch links that the other public pages have.
Internal nav links use href='x.html', so with cleanUrls every click costs an extra 308 redirect hop (e.g. activities.html -> /activities).
vercel.json sets no security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy). Prod only returns HSTS.

/data responses send access-control-allow-origin: * (api/data.js:49,64), which conflicts with the project rule 'Restrict CORS to trusted domains'. Preview responses are no-store, but CORS is still wildcard.

The preview tool was capped at 5 servers (held by other auditors), so I ran the same devserver command (node .claude/audit/devserver.mjs . 8908) as a background shell job on my assigned port 8908, and stopped it at the end.

gallery.html, assets/gallery.js, assets/gallery.css, assets/videos.js, assets/videos.css and assets/lattice.svg are untracked (git status '??'), but the modified tracked pages load them (activities.html:14,18; knowledge.html:15,20). Production returns 404 for /gallery, /assets/gallery.js and /assets/videos.js today. If deploys come from git, these files must be committed or the album viewer and video section break.

Album 'Steadfastness 2026' is dated 2026-10-26, which is in the future. The photos show '26 SEP 2026' and the activity is 26 ก.ย., so it sorts first with the wrong date. 'Steadfastness' (27 ก.ย.) and 'Steadfastness 2026' look like duplicates to a visitor.

The per-card mini-maps search by name, so unverified addresses may show the wrong spot.

UX opinion: /halal-map lists 23 restaurants in no particular order, with no distance, area filter or search. The place closest to CMU (Halal Kitchen CMU MED) is 10th. Campus prayer rooms are mixed in with city mosques. A 'ใกล้ มช.' sort or chips (ในมช. / นิมมาน / ช้างคลาน) would help newcomers.

Activities have no time field (admin form fields: title, date, location, description, featured, cover). The public featured card has a time slot that is always hidden, so students can't see when an event starts.
The first video's date (30 ส.ค. 2569) is the YouTube upload date, while the event was 15 ส.ค. (the second video's date comes from its description). The same calendar icon is used for both meanings.

Each video playlist item contains the 'กำลังเปิด' label hidden only with opacity:0, so screen readers announce 'now playing' on every item. activities and halal-map have no <main> element (document.querySelector('main') returned null).

'บันทึกและดูตัวอย่าง' opens the generic list page (/activities.html?preview), not the item just saved. For a future, non-featured activity the preview won't show it at all (see the HIGH issue), which makes the preview look broken to the admin.

The knowledge tile 'ถามคำถามศาสนา · ส่งคำถามมาพูดคุยกับพี่ ๆ ในชมรม' goes to about#contact, which only offers Instagram and Facebook (no email or form there; the email is only in the footer). It is a soft dead end for someone who wants to ask a question.
The preview bar on public pages ('ดูตัวอย่างไม่ได้ …', 'ออกจากโหมดตัวอย่าง') stays in Thai when EN is on. It is admin-only, so this is low priority.
Environment: the browser preview tool refused a 6th server ('Maximum 5 servers per worktree'), so the same devserver command ran via Bash on port 8904 and was stopped at the end.

anon/authenticated still have the Supabase default table grants (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE) on public tables. RLS blocks the first three and PostgREST does not expose TRUNCATE, so this is defense-in-depth only: consider revoking write privileges from anon.

Google sign-in is open (disable_signup=false), so any Google account that clicks 'Sign in' gets an auth.users row before admin.js signs it out. Harmless to data, but auth.users fills with strangers. You could restrict this with an auth hook or by disabling signup after the admins have their accounts.
admin.js runBoot treats a missing 'role' column as owner (fallback for before migration 0006). The live DB has 0006 applied, so the fallback can be removed.

Production still runs the old api/data.js: /data?sheet=youtube returns 400 'unknown sheet', and /data?sheet=all&preview=1 is served from the public edge cache (HIT) by old code that ignores preview. After deploy, check that preview=1 returns 'private, no-store'. Vercel purges the CDN per deployment.

Could not start my own preview server through preview_start (the pane allows 5 servers max and the others were running), so I ran the same launch.json command via Bash on port 8905 and stopped it afterwards.

assets/photo/view.jpg (6000x3375, 9.9MB) and assets/_src/* (logo PNGs 1.8 to 2.9MB each, about 8.6MB total) are gitignored and unreferenced. A Git-integration deploy skips them, but there is no .vercelignore, so a `vercel` CLI deploy from this working tree could upload them. Unverified.

_initCarousel (api.js:1131) autoplays every 3.8s with no prefers-reduced-motion check (the featured slider at api.js:478 does check). It applies to the halal, members, gallery-strip and past-events carousels.
gallery.html has no window.MCCMU_SUPABASE inline config, unlike the other public pages, so site.js tracking skips /gallery views (site.js:189).
The album sessionStorage key is 'mccmu_albums_v2_sheets_published' even though the data source is Supabase (_SRC is empty, so it falls back to 'sheets'). Cosmetic only, no collision observed.
i18n setLang clears its `switching` flag inside requestAnimationFrame. While a tab is hidden, rAF never fires, so a second language toggle was ignored in the hidden test tab. Edge case.
drive-image-test.html sits at the repo root and would be deployed as a public page.
The i18n textOrig Map keeps references to text nodes that the 30s prayer-strip re-render (or any re-render) removes in EN mode. It is a slow, minor memory growth only on very long-open tabs.

During one fresh load, /activities briefly rendered a different dataset (13 activities, last dated 2026-08-01, keys without albums) cached in mccmu_all_v1, while /data?sheet=all returns 19 activities (last 2026-10-11) on every direct fetch. This may be the api.js:91 fallback to Apps Script (older Sheets data) after a transient /data failure. If so, a /data hiccup would show visitors stale content. Not reproduced.
In preview mode with a rejected token, /data?…&preview=1 answers 502 Bad Gateway rather than 401/403.
In preview mode the gallery requests /data?sheet=albums&status=published&preview=1, so draft albums may never appear in preview.
Every .vitem in the YouTube list contains a 'กำลังเปิด' label hidden only with opacity:0, so screen readers announce 'now playing' on all 3 items.
The header brand text is '˚𝜗𝜚˚ชมรมมุสลิม' (assets/site.js:38). The decorative math glyphs are read aloud by screen readers and copied into the i18n MAP.
Content: the knowledge card title 'Highlight Kutbah' probably should be 'Khutbah'. All 3 home picks show the same date (28 มิ.ย. 2569).

The hero h1 uses line-height about 1.06 (65.7px on 62px Anuphan) for two lines of Thai. No collision was seen in Chromium, but stacked tone marks under upper vowels have little headroom. Worth a check in Safari.
